problem: The remainder bound is printed as "0≤r21 is the remainder", which is not a valid inequality. The "<" plus the following letter was read as an HTML tag and the text "r1" disappeared, so a student sees a meaningless "0≤r21".
fix: Write the bound with a space after the "<" so it is not treated as a tag: "... and 0 ≤ r2 < r1 is the remainder".

problem: "0≤r<b" puts "<" straight against the letter b; the browser can read "<b" as the start of a bold tag and swallow the rest of the line.
fix: Write it with a space: "q=⌊a/b⌋, r=a−qb, and 0 ≤ r < b".

where: Section 3 and the lead-adjacent notation in Q7 area
problem: "x mod n is the inverse a−1 mod n" and "d=e−1 mod φ(n)" print the exponent −1 on the baseline, so students can read "a minus 1" instead of "a inverse".
fix: Use a superscript or brackets: a⁻¹ mod n, d = e⁻¹ mod φ(n), or write "the inverse of a".

problem: The recurrence is written r_i = r_(i−2) − q r_(i−1) with an unlabelled q, but the quotient here is the one from the step that produced r_(i−1), not any earlier quotient.
